why: assets.manifest.json only carries the _middle variant of this image, which is what the Studio runtime loads at 1440 (rendered 644px). At 768 (rendered 401.59px) and 390 (rendered 318px) the runtime swaps in the _small variant, verified live in extract/data.states.json -> imageVariantsByViewport. Both files are needed for the 768 and 390 visual diffs to match.
